name: smwmusic-super-mario-kart-yoshi-s-rank
title: Super Mario Kart - Yoshi's Rank
description:
This is a short but sweet song. It was very fun to work on.
I personally have always enjoyed the remixed feel to Super Mario Kart and how it redoes aspects of older songs.
This could work well as some kind of goal theme or perhaps a bonus theme.
